skyabs 'gro ni/ na mo: bla ma bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku: dkon mchog gsum gyi rang bzhin la: bdag dang 'gro drug sems can rnams: byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi: na mo: bla ma bde gshegs 'dus pa'i gsung: rtsa ba gsum gyi rang bzhin la: bdag dang 'gro drug sems can rnams: byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi: na mo: bla ma bde gshegs 'dus pa'i thugs: sku gsum bla ma'i rang bzhin la: bdag dang 'gro drug sems can rnams: byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi: sems bskyed ni/ sems bskyed 'gro ba kun don du: dkon mchog gsum po bsgrubs nas ni: gang la gang 'dul phrin las kyis: 'gro don byed par sems bskyed do: sems bskyed 'gro ba kun don du: rtsa ba gsum po bsgrubs nas ni: gang la gang 'dul phrin las kyis: 'gro don byed par sems bskyed do: sems bskyed 'gro ba kun don du: sku gsum bla ma bsgrubs nas ni: gang la gang 'dul phrin las kyis: 'gro don byed par sems bskyed do: yan lag bcu pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum po gshegs su gsol: nyi zla padma'i gdan la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul: nyams chag 'gal 'khrul ci mchis bshags: gsang sngags sgrub la rjes yi rang: smin grol gsang sngags chos 'khor bskor: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs: snying po sems can don du bsngo: yang dag rdo rje'i don rtogs shog: rtsa ba gsum po gshegs su gsol: nyi zla padma'i gdan la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul: nyams chag 'gal 'khrul ci mchis bshags: gsang sngags sgrub la rjes yi rang: smin grol gsang sngags chos 'khor bskor: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs: snying po sems can don du bsngo: yang dag rdo rje'i don rtogs shog: sku gsum bla ma gshegs su gsol: nyi zla padma'i gdan la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal:

phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul: nyams chag 'gal 'khrul ci mchis bshags: gsang sngags sgrub la rjes yi rang: smin grol gsang sngags chos 'khor bskor: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs: snying po sems can don du bsngo: yang dag rdo rje'i don rtogs shog: maṇḍal ni/ na mo: bkod pa mdzes ldan rin chen maṇḍal mchog: ri rab gling bzhi gling phran nyi zlas spras: rin chen 'dod lnga kun bzang mchod sprin gtibs: dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa gsum sku gsum mchod: bdag sogs 'gro ba ma lus bskyab tu gsol: tshogs rdzogs sgrib byang sku gsum myur thob shog: sgrib sbyong ni/ skyabs yul sku gsung thugs nyid kyi: gnas gsum 'bru gsum 'od zer 'phros: phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas mchod: 'od zer tshur 'dus bdag lus phog: sgo gsum las nyon ma lus sbyangs: phar 'phros rigs drug sems can gyi: sdig sgrib sbyangs nas sa la bkod: slar yang tshur 'dus bdag lus thim: rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs dbang thob: oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes ci nus bzla/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ bla ma sangs rgyas chos sku la: gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: snang srid rgyal ba'i sku nyid du: da lta nyid du 'char bar shog: bla ma yi dam longs sku la: gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: sgra grags rgyal ba'i gsung nyid du: da lta nyid du rtogs par shog: bla ma mkha' 'gro sprul sku la: gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: dran rtog rgyal ba'i thugs nyid du: da lta nyid du rtogs par shog: ༈ brgyud 'debs dge slong pad phrin pa rang nyid kyis sbyar ba ni/ srid zhi'i khams kun gdod ma'i zhing*// bya rtsol bral ba dngos po'i gshis// 'dus ma byas pa chos kyi sku// mtha' yas zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// lhun grub longs sku'i tshul 'dzin pa// stong nyid snying rje'i rnam rol mchog /'gro ba'i mun sel yid bzhin nor// pad dkar 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs// ma lus rgyal ba'i phrin las pa// brtul zhugs mngon gyur he ru ka

/dus gsum sgrib med mkhyen gyur pa'i// pad 'byung zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// gang gi gsang mchog gdams pa'i mdzod// 'dzin pa'i snod ldan las 'phro can// thugs sras 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon mchog /dag pa'i 'khor lngar gsol ba 'debs// zhen log mthar phyin mdzad pa yis// dka' spyad sgrub la rtse gcig gzhol// rnal 'byor dbang phyug legs ldan rje// bdud 'joms zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// mgon de'i bka' gter gdams pa yi// snod du gyur pa 'jam dpal dbyangs// mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug ces grags pa'i// mkhas dbang rje la gsol ba 'debs// gsang chen bla na med pa yi// bstan pa'i sgron me rdo rje 'chang*// dbang phyug rab brtan phan bde'i gter// dam pa mchog la gsol ba 'debs// rab 'byams 'khor lo'i mgon po ba// bdag sogs 'gro ba'i bsod nams dpal// rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog ldan la// mi phyed dad pas gsol ba 'debs// 'od gsal rdo rje snying po yi// bshad sgrub rgyal mtshan 'dzin mdzad pa'i// mkhas grub chos dbyings rang grol la// gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba 'debs// bslab gsum rin chen tshul khrims ldan// stong nyid chos sku'i gnas lugs skyong*// rjes thob snying rje'i rnam rol can// pad phrin zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// snang srid 'khor 'das srid zhi kun// zab med 'od gsal chos kyi sku// cir snang dag pa rab 'byams su// da lta nyid du 'char bar shog /'di bzung byang chub ma thob par// rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam la// thos bsam sgom pa mthar phyin nas// 'gro ba'i ded dpon byed par shog / ces pa 'di yang brgyud pa'i kha skong gi tshul du bgyid par yun ring mo zhig nas bsams kyang g.yeng bas phyi bshol du lus pa las/ phyis rab 'byams pa bstan pa rab rgyas kyis bskul zhing rang nyid kyang lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas/ padma'i bsti gnas yang rdzong drag sngags phug gi gnas su lha rigs kyi rnal 'byor padma phrin las kyis sbyar ba dge

/ dngos gzhi'i nyams len ni/ 'di ltar mig gi yul du snang ba yi: phyi nang snod bcud snang ba thams cad kun: snang yang bden 'dzin med pa'i ngang la zhog: gzung 'dzin dag pa gsal stong lha yi sku: 'dod chags rang grol bla mar gsol ba 'debs: gzugs stong pa'o: stong pa nyid gzugs so: gzugs las kyang stong pa nyid gzhan ma yin: stong pa nyid las kyang gzugs gzhan ma yin no: 'di ltar rna ba'i yul du grags pa yi: snyan dang mi snyan grags pa'i sgra rnams kun: grags stong bsam mno bral ba'i ngang la zhog: grags stong skye 'gag med pa rgyal ba'i gsung: grags stong rgyal ba'i gsung la gsol ba 'debs: sgra stong pa'o: stong pa nyid sgra'o: sgra las kyang stong pa nyid gzhan ma yin: stong pa nyid las kyang sgra gzhan ma yin no: 'di ltar yid kyi yul du 'gyu ba yi: nyon mongs dug lnga'i rtog pa ci shar yang: sngon bsu rjes dpyod blo yis bcos mi gzhug: 'gyu ba rang sar bzhag pas chos skur grol: rig pa rang grol bla mar gsol ba 'debs: sems stong pa'o: stong pa nyid sems so: sems las kyang stong pa nyid gzhan ma yin: stong pa nyid las kyang sems gzhan ma yin no: 'di'i lung gi brgyud pa ni/ rig 'dzin padma phrin las yan khrid yig ltar la/ des bya btang su dhī artha/ des lha rigs ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas la'o// dge legs 'phel/// /
